paths.title: Claude Advanced
paths.tagline: Turn Claude from a chat tool into your professional operating system.
paths.description: The expert tier of the Claude track. You will architect AI-assisted workflows for whole business processes, connect Claude to your real tools safely with MCP, run multi-step and browser-based automation under supervision, build verified research pipelines, author your own Skills, and manage models and usage like a budget. The course closes with high-stakes verification protocols, scaled content operations, and assembling everything — Projects, Skills, MCP and automation — into a personal AI operating system with a maintenance loop that keeps it compounding.
